DRAFT
At Veridian Bio I owned the ETL pipeline for our Phase II and Phase III clinical trial data — lab
results, adverse event reports, dosing records from 14 investigational sites. This was data going
directly into regulatory submissions, so when the second audit asked why a specific transformation
rule had changed between protocol versions, I had to reconstruct the answer from Git history and
Slack threads because the original spec no longer existed in any findable form. I built a
transformation registry after that: every rule change logged with the date, the reason, and the
protocol version it corresponded to. The third audit took half the time of the second.
